hints: For a fixed sell day, which buy day is best?
The best buy day for selling on day r is the cheapest day before r. Can you track it as you go?
One pass: keep the lowest price so far (l); at each day r, the candidate profit is prices[r] − prices[l].

insight.mnemonic: Buy the dip you've already seen.
insight.oneLiner: Sweep once, remembering the cheapest buy so far; each day's best sale is price − cheapest-so-far.

recall.a: When today's price is below prices[l] - a new cheapest buy day.
You can always choose not to trade.

insight.why: For any sell day the optimal buy is the minimum before it, so one running minimum covers all O(n²) pairs.

solutions.idea: Check the profit of every (buy, sell) pair with buy < sell.
solutions.name: Try every buy/sell pair

footnotes.text: Moving l to a new low never loses an answer: every later sale is better paired with the lower price. That's why one pass suffices.

class Solution:
    def maxProfit(self, prices: List[int]) -> int:
statement:
`prices[i]` is a stock's price on day `i`. You may **buy once** and later **sell once** (selling must happen on a later day than buying).

Return the maximum profit you can make. If no trade makes money, return `0`.
title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
